FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 69
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/10/2026
Senate Bill 69 as introduced would decrease individual income tax receipts to the Education
Trust Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon: (1) the number of civilian employees
of the Department of Defense filing for the state income tax exemption authorized pursuant to
the provisions of this bill; (2) the salaries of the individuals filing; (3) the effective income tax
rates of the individuals filing; and (4) the actual number of days the civilian employees are
deployed away from the primary work locations. Based upon the estimated number of civilian
employees deployed for the past five years and estimated average salaries, the Education Trust
Fund could see a decrease of $114,000 annually, beginning in FY 2028.
